messages:
Maria: Heads up — prepping social push for Launch v2. Need final assets + two thread drafts (benchmark angle + how-to angle) by EOD Tue. CTA variations and UTM strings please. @Jordan can you confirm hero GIF + 3 sizes? :pray:
Jordan: Yep — GIF is done. Uploading full set to Drive now. Will include 1:1, 9:16, 16:9 and a square thumb.
Maria: Awesome. Also want a short 3-tweet thread version for X and a longer LinkedIn thread. Sam — which inbound routing should we use: demo signups or webinar?
Sam: Webinar — higher lead quality for this audience. I'll map inbound to SDR queue `webinar-warm` and tag with source `x_launch_v2`. Also will add a flow to ping AE Slack channel for >= qualified leads.
Alex: Adsync note — recommend reserving two paid X slots (AM/PM) and one LinkedIn sponsored post midday PT. Do we have budget sign-off? If so I'll queue boosts.
Maria: Budget approved for modest boosts. Prioritize best-performing variant after hour 1.
Jordan: Uploaded assets: https://drive.redwood.ai/rlw/launch_v2/assets (thumb + gif + clips). File names: launch_v2_thumb.png, launch_v2_16_9.mp4, launch_v2_gif.gif
Maria: Draft copy (benchmark angle) — please iterate and shorten for X thread:
Jordan: (thread copy suggestion)
Maria: 1) "Benchmarks matter: how we cut token cost 3x with smart batching \ud83d\udc47"
Maria: 2) "Quick results: 99th pctl latency dropped from 320ms to 95ms after model routing"
Maria: 3) "We built the runtime so teams can ship predictably — sign up for the webinar for deep dive → [link]"
Sam: Add tracking param: `?utm_campaign=launch_v2&utm_medium=social&utm_source=x` to the webinar link.
Maria: Noted, will bake into final CTAs.
Maya: I'll own live engagement for the first 2 hours — reply plan: 1) thanks + link to webinar 2) ask if they want a demo 3) add to warm list if positive.
Alex: Scheduling snippet for automation (posting times in PT):
```
Wed 09:00 — X organic (thread, benchmark lead)
Wed 09:05 — X paid boost (AM slot)
Wed 12:00 — LinkedIn organic post (long thread)
Wed 17:00 — X paid boost (PM slot)
```
Jordan: Final size pack and alt text uploaded by 5:30pm PT.
Maria: Can someone please proof the LinkedIn long form? Short bullets + 3 screenshots.
Sam: I'll run the UTM & inbox test now and confirm capture to CRM.
LaunchBot: Reminder: calendar slot confirmed — Wed 09:00 PT posting automation set (job id: job_2746).
Alex: Scheduling set in Sprout for the organic posts, boosts queued pending final copy.
Maya: Engagement plan ready. I'll compile a 1-hour priorities list and share after the post.
Jordan: Sending final copy now in thread and in Drive.
Maria: Beautiful — thanks team :rocket: Good to go once Sam confirms CRM mapping and Alex hits publish.
Sam: CRM mapping verified. All UTM tags captured and SDR queue active.
Alex: Publish confirmed at 09:00 PT. Boosts go live at 09:05 and 17:00 PT.
Maya: I'll post engagement highlights 1h after launch.
Maria: Perfect — closing this thread. If anything urgent ping me in DMs. :white_check_mark:
